caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass bowl situated centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bowl has a wide, flared form with gently sloping sides and a scalloped, wavy rim. The glass is rendered with subtle blue and grey shading to indicate transparency and reflective qualities, and there are delicate vertical fluted patterns and highlights on the bowl’s surface. The short pedestal base is round with ribbed detailing, and the foot is solid and circular. The composition is minimal, with the bowl alone in the center, and a small signature reading "Joseph Mihaly" appears slightly to the right below the bowl.
title: Dish
